title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock
prompt: You're given an array `prices` where `prices[i]` is the price of a stock on day `i`. You may buy the stock on one day and sell it on a later day. Return the maximum profit achievable. Return `0` if no profit is possible.

examples.explanation: Buy on day 1 (price 1), sell on day 4 (price 6), profit = 5
Prices only fall, so no profitable transaction exists

hints: This isn't a fixed-size window — it's a running minimum plus a running best answer.
As you scan left to right, track the lowest price seen so far. At each day, the best sell profit is today's price minus that running minimum.
Keep a single pass: update the running minimum, then update the best profit with (price - runningMin), in that order, at each index.

solution.approach: Track the lowest price seen so far while scanning left to right. At each day, if selling today beats the best profit found so far, update it. This is a one-pass sliding window where the window's left edge is implicitly 'the cheapest day so far'.
